name: sx/bonus-card
title: SX Bonus / Feature Card
description: Offer card (amount, code, terms) or, where offers are restricted, a feature card with brand proof points.

guardrails: mode=offer auto-switches to mode=feature in markets where promotions.welcome_bonus is 'restricted' (all three demo markets).
Offer cards always show a terms line next to the amount, not below the fold.
